secrets.name: The Platform in the Fog
secrets.text: Only one of the staircases goes anywhere, and it comes here: a desk hung from the ceiling on rods, a lamp, a book left open. From up here the stairs below look like a forest in winter.

meta.label: The Stair Forest
meta.blurb: Staircases, hundreds of them, going up into the mist. Most of them stop. Some of them start in the air. You have the feeling that one of them goes somewhere.
